limits: One local replica-set member, no failover or network-fault simulation.
Requests and OTP authorization metadata are synthetic seeds; this harness does not execute signup or OTP creation/verification.
Photo pins/sealed receipts are synthetic; no S3 bytes, provider dispatch or remote closure evidence.
Reply loss occurs after an acknowledged real Mongo commit; close error is observed after real endSession succeeds, not UnknownTransactionCommitResult.
Capture continuity uses a dossier without files and stops at COPYING; no ownership, period closure, publication or history-access commit.
The 120 media scenarios and previous 47 flow scenarios were not run under this authorization.
